name: Sterling Group Holdings Limited
summary: Sterling Group Holdings Limited is an investment holding firm that makes and distributes apparel worldwide, selling in Hong Kong, the US, the UK, Italy and other regions. Based in San Po Kong since 1993, its range covers outerwear, trousers, shirts, blouses, dresses, suits and sleepwear. It also manages and licenses trademarks, and its customers are leading international apparel brands.
